label: A6BC14D3_oP48_30_3c_a_7c_bc-001
title: Room Temperature Bi$_{5}$PbTi$_{3}$O$_{14}$Cl Structure
comments:
This is the room temperature form of Bi$_{5}$PbTi$_{3}$O$_{14}$Cl, with data taken at 25$^{\circ}$. 
 Above 590$^{\circ}$ it transforms into the \href{current_web_home_dir/A6BC14D3_tP24_123_g2h_c_e2g2i_bg-001}{tetragonal high-temperature structure}. 
 The bismuth (4c) sites are actually 83.3\% bismuth and 16.7\% lead. 
 (Kusainova, 2002) give the data for this structure in the $P2an$ setting of space group \#30. We used AFLOW to translate it to the standard $Pnc2$ setting, which reorders the axes. 
 Space group $Pnc2$ does not specify the origin of the z-axis.  (Kusainova, 2002) set $z_{4} = 0$ for the Bi II site.
